paragraphs: Okay, friend, here's the big idea. The LORD doesn't just announce what's coming for Babylon. He turns to His own people and says, "Come out of her, My people! Save your lives, each of you, from the fierce anger of the LORD." (Jeremiah 51:45) God cares about what happens to His people when the big stuff comes down. He gives them a way out, and He tells them to take it.

And take it NOW, because He says, "You who have escaped the sword, depart and do not linger!" (Jeremiah 51:50) He also tells them not to be afraid when the rumors roll in (Jeremiah 51:46). I know that feeling, when every headline says the sky is falling. But the LORD says Babylon will fall even if she "ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold" (Jeremiah 51:53), so no fortress is bigger than His word. Her thick walls were leveled, the people's labor was for nothing, and the LORD of Hosts is the King who said so (Jeremiah 51:57-58).

So what does that mean for you, baker? Don't get comfortable anywhere that isn't home for God's people. Remember the LORD, keep Jerusalem on your mind (Jeremiah 51:50), and when the world gets loud, trust the One who is still King when the noise dies down. This story isn't over, and I'm keeping my ovens ready!
